fusions.name: Hurled Spoil
fusions.desc: Hurls a slab of seabed up to 6 tiles that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Spade Edge
fusions.desc: A short chop that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Leaden] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried Polyps
fusions.desc: Buries a nest of stinging polyps beneath the nearest enemy. It waits 40 seconds, then bursts for 24 damage in a blast around it that hits the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, healing you receive rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
